overrides.reason: this repository lints with its own, stricter .golangci.yml (the CLI required job's gate, packs/reference/languages/go/guidance/14-lint-config.md); a check with no config lets golangci-lint discover it, instead of the reference pack's generic starting-point config.

internal/redact's own tests intentionally contain fixture strings shaped like AWS credentials, to prove the redactor catches them before they ever reach an artifact or stderr; this repo's own gitleaks config allowlists that one path instead of the reference pack's generic one.
